title: NCAA Division I FBS football win–loss records
basis: NCAA official (vacated victories and NCAA forfeits applied, per the article lead)
wikitext:
{{Short description|none}}
The following data is current through the end of the [[2024 NCAA Division I FBS football season|2024 season]], which culminated in the [[2025 College Football Playoff National Championship]]. The following list reflects the records according to the [[National Collegiate Athletic Association|NCAA]]. Not all wins and losses in this list have occurred in the highest level of play, but are recognized by the NCAA. This list takes into account results modified later due to NCAA action, such as [[vacated victories]] and forfeits. Winning percentages are rounded to three decimal places. In the event of a tie, the team with highest unrounded percentage is listed first.
